title: insert().select() still used in execution repos
reproduction: Supabase runtime here fails on .insert().select() (same issue previously seen on previews).
fix_idea: Drop .select() after insert and follow signal_previews pattern (generate UUID client-side, on conflict fetch id).

title: Risk engine fabricates UUID when decision.id missing
evidence_snippets: evaluate sets dec_id = decision.id or uuid4(); verdict.decision_id uses dec_id
reproduction: Call RiskEngineV1.evaluate with DecisionV1 without id → verdict decision_id not tied to DB row.
fix_idea: Require decision.id to be set (raise/log) before evaluate; avoid generating new UUIDs.

title: Telemetry keys inconsistent (preview_id vs signal_preview_id)
evidence_snippets: persist_control_decision_and_verdict error paths log data with "preview_id"
main loop logs errors with "signal_preview_id" elsewhere
reproduction: Force decision persist to fail; risk_event data key differs from other logs, complicating joins.
fix_idea: Standardize on data.signal_preview_id everywhere for control-plane telemetry.

title: Risk_event logging failures silently ignored in persist paths
evidence_snippets: risk_events_repo.insert in exception blocks is wrapped with bare except pass (only limited stderr prints)
reproduction: If risk_events insert fails (e.g., RLS/env), persist errors become silent except one-off stderr.
fix_idea: Log stderr consistently and consider fallback counter/flag to surface logging failures.

title: SUPABASE_URL/SERVICE_ROLE missing causes hard crash without telemetry
evidence_snippets: SupabaseDB.__init__ raises RuntimeError if envs missing; no risk_event emitted
reproduction: Launch without SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY → process exits, no diagnostics.
fix_idea: Add early risk_event/clear error message before exiting; optionally guard main startup.

title: Enum/casing drift between schema and models
evidence_snippets: DB stores direction/setup_type as unconstrained text
Models enforce Direction enum with lowercase values
reproduction: Insert preview with wrong casing via direct SQL → passes DB, breaks model expectations.
fix_idea: Add CHECK/enum constraints or validation in repos before insert.

title: risk_modifier bounds differ between model and DB
evidence_snippets: risk_modifier numeric NOT NULL (no constraint) in DB
reproduction: Write decision with risk_modifier=10 via SQL → accepted by DB, violates model contract.
fix_idea: Add CHECK constraint or validate in repo before insert.

title: Legacy tables remain alongside control-plane schema
reproduction: Querying without table scoping can hit legacy tables instead of control_* equivalents.
fix_idea: Document deprecation or drop/rename legacy tables in a later migration; update queries/tests.

title: No lint/static analysis configured
reproduction: Run ruff/flake8 → not configured; potential style/type issues remain hidden.
fix_idea: Add lint/static checks to CI to catch attr access/typing issues early.

title: Idempotency conflict paths untested for control_decisions/risk_verdicts
evidence_snippets: Unit tests only cover happy path UUID generation; conflict lookup branches not exercised
reproduction: Conflict (duplicate signal_preview_id/risk_version) not covered; potential regressions unnoticed.
fix_idea: Add tests simulating duplicate insert to assert lookup code returns existing id.
